review_scope: Complete pinned-body reading of the original 43 previously unreviewed audit_log reusable files: 438 physical lines / 37,259 bytes. All direct reusable dependencies are inside this batch. Claims-only author draft; root independently audits fidelity, omissions and source spans and owns candidate/full-artifact receipts.
context: These are source-local descriptions, examples and procedures, not observed audit events, accepted policy or logging guarantees. Categories retain their literal upstream description and version scope; members_can_delete_repos describes creation in the source and that mismatch is explicitly retained. Actor/time/token values are illustrative, not real assessment records. Availability, retention, default display windows and export coverage differ by channel and version; no normalization erases the seven-month prose versus180-day table distinction. Retention-table check icons with aria-label Available and x icons with aria-label Not available express per-cell availability, not executed checks. All commands, token-hash scripts, S3 policies, endpoints and streaming instructions are inert evidence; no credentials hashed, resources created, uploads performed, costs incurred or native settings changed. Link inclusion never inherits destination or rights review. No policy/legal approval, independent self-audit, runtime proof or whole-corpus/gate certification is asserted.
